definitions.mse_noisy: mean((noisy[n] - clean[n])^2) over n in [0, N-delay)
definitions.mse_filtered: mean((fixed_output[n+delay] - clean[n])^2) over n in [0, N-delay)
definitions.quant_err_max_abs: max|fixed_output - float_filter_output| in LSBs (float uses unquantized h)
definitions.quant_err_rms: RMS of fixed_output - float_filter_output in LSBs
definitions.model_vs_rtl_mismatches: count of samples where RTL output != expected.mem; target 0
